payload.name: Date-Range Search for Temporal Queries
payload.description: When a question asks where someone was or what they did during a specific calendar period (week, month, date range) and initial hybrid/keyword searches return only interests or plans, run a structured search filtered to that period's date range before answering.
content: When the question specifies a calendar period, issue one structured search over memories whose world_start (or event time) overlaps that period, using the period's concrete date range as the filter; do not rely only on keywords like the month name because memories may store relative time phrases such as 'last Friday'.

Do not treat memories expressing interest, desire, or future plans to visit a place as evidence that the person was there during the asked period; only an event memory whose timestamp falls within the period supports the answer.
After one structured date-range search, stop expanding; if no overlapping event memory is found, answer that the information is not available from memory.

solves: When a question asks where someone was during a named calendar period, keyword search can miss memories that use relative time words like 'last Friday' instead of the month/week name, leading agents to infer the location from interest or plan memories. Apply when the question specifies a calendar period and initial searches return only preferences or plans; run a structured date-range search. Do not apply when no time-window is required, where ordinary search suffices.
